details.title: Phrygian scales
details.lead: Phrygian: minor with a lowered 2nd, the dark Spanish sound. Each key goes up and down two octaves from its lowest tonic, then over the whole horn: up to the highest note of the scale at or below double high B♭, down to the lowest, and back to the tonic.
facts: All 12, from B♭ up by half steps
